decisions.reason: The required font families are already captured by a complete same-message MODIFY on this Requirement.
The required Alan Sans and Plus Jakarta Sans font assets are already captured by a complete same-message MODIFY.
The wizard's required font families do not change the landing page's existing use of Alan Sans for headlines.
Portrait support and layout placeholders for the provisioning wizard do not modify the landing page's responsive-layout requirement.
The wizard typography update does not alter the shared website footer requirement.
The source concerns styling guidance for the provisioning wizard, not the independently scoped admin workspace shell.
The provisioning-wizard font requirements do not change the landing page sign-up call to action.
Wizard typography and unresolved node-accent styling do not change the established dark theme for website pages.
The wizard's provisional chevron asset and typography do not necessarily change the landing page's How It Works content or sequence visual.
The source does not change the landing-page hero text emphasis or otherwise address hero presentation.
Using the existing build approach for a wizard does not modify the landing page's plain HTML and Tailwind CSS stack.
Wizard-specific portrait and landscape gap placeholders do not modify the reusable responsive breakpoint guidance.
